policy: El registro diferencia fuentes oficiales inspeccionadas a nivel de página/metadatos de documentos leídos íntegramente. Una referencia no equivale a evidencia experimental ni validación experta. Las referencias nuevas de esta ampliación se han verificado a nivel de ficha/versión oficial, no como lectura integral. Actualización 2026-11-24: las páginas oficiales OWASP GenAI LLM Top 10 2026, OWASP GenAI Red Teaming Guide y NIST AI 200-3 fueron consultadas a nivel de página; sus estados no equivalen a lectura integral ni a claims respaldados.

sources.title: Guide to Integrating Forensic Techniques into Incident Response

sources.title: Guidelines on Mobile Device Forensics

sources.title: IoT Non-Technical Supporting Capability Core Baseline

sources.title: Foundational Activities for IoT Product Manufacturers
sources.review_note: 2026 revision; obtain and review full publication before deriving requirements.

sources.title: Platform Firmware Resiliency Guidelines

sources.title: NIST Privacy Framework
sources.review_note: Risk management framework; confirm current resources and jurisdictional applicability.

sources.title: IoT Device Cybersecurity Capabilities Catalog
sources.review_note: Detailed capability statements refine NISTIR 8259A/B; snapshot version for reproducible mappings.

sources.title: Implementation Resources for SP 800-63 Revision 4
sources.review_note: Includes implementation resources, conformance criteria and reference architectures.

sources.title: Adversarial Machine Learning: A Taxonomy and Terminology of Attacks and Mitigations
sources.review_note: Supersedes E2023 as newer taxonomy; includes predictive and generative AI attacks and mitigations.

sources.title: Technical Guide to Information Security Testing and Assessment
sources.review_note: Older overview of test planning and techniques; not a comprehensive modern assessment program.

sources.title: Guide to Intrusion Detection and Prevention Systems
sources.review_note: 2007 final; draft Rev. 1 was retired in 2022 and never finalized. Use only as historical foundation.

sources.title: Information Security Continuous Monitoring
sources.review_note: Foundational continuous monitoring guidance; supplement with current architecture and telemetry practice.

sources.title: Common Attack Pattern Enumeration and Classification
sources.review_note: Catalog of attack patterns; fix version and map carefully to CWE/ATT&CK/OWASP.

sources.title: D3FEND Defensive Countermeasure Knowledge Graph
sources.review_note: Knowledge graph vocabulary of defensive techniques; does not prescribe, prioritize or rate effectiveness.

sources.title: Sigma Rule Specification
sources.review_note: Portable detection rule format; backend conversion and semantic equivalence require tests.

sources.title: Zeek Documentation
sources.review_note: Network security monitoring platform; record version, scripts and data model.

sources.title: Suricata User Guide
sources.review_note: IDS/IPS/NSM engine; test rule performance, false positives and version-specific features.

sources.title: IEEE 802.11 Wireless LAN Working Group
sources.review_note: Full standards may require access; cite exact amendment/edition for normative claims.

sources.title: Bluetooth Core Specification
sources.review_note: Pin exact Core version and feature set for security analysis.

sources.title: NFC Forum Specifications
sources.review_note: Review exact specification and licensing/access requirements.

sources.title: NIST Cloud Computing Forensic Reference Architecture
sources.review_note: Final architecture for forensic readiness; customize to provider/service and jurisdiction.

sources.title: Guide for Cybersecurity Event Recovery
sources.review_note: Recovery planning/playbooks; complement with current cloud and ransomware practice.

sources.title: Contingency Planning Guide for Federal Information Systems
sources.review_note: Foundational but old; supplement with current resilience requirements.

sources.title: Security Requirements for Cryptographic Modules
sources.review_note: Validation applies to exact module/version/operating environment and certificate scope.

sources.title: Transitioning the Use of Cryptographic Algorithms and Key Lengths

sources.title: Domain-Based Message Authentication, Reporting, and Conformance (DMARC)

sources.title: DMARC Aggregate Reporting

sources.title: DMARC Failure Reporting
sources.review_note: DMARC failure reporting specification; coordinate with RFC 9989.

sources.title: Sender Policy Framework (SPF)

sources.title: DomainKeys Identified Mail (DKIM) Signatures

sources.title: BIOS Protection Guidelines

sources.title: IoT Device Cybersecurity Guidance for the Federal Government

sources.title: IoT Product Cybersecurity Guidelines Rev. 1 Initial Public Draft

sources.title: UN Regulation No. 155 — Cyber security and cybersecurity management systems

sources.title: Reference Architecture for Space Data Systems

sources.title: Vulnerability Disclosure Cheat Sheet

sources.title: Automated Threats to Web Applications

sources.title: Database Security Cheat Sheet

sources.title: Security and Privacy Controls for Information Systems and Organizations

sources.title: CIS Benchmarks

sources.title: CISA Malware Analysis and Incident Response resources
